ui.an_administrator_must_give_a_reason: An administrator must give a reason. The exclusion is recorded in the audit trail.
ui.automatic_protection_keeps_running_on: Automatic protection keeps running on every device. These are the actions that need a person to decide.
ui.by_default_the_agent_sends_security: By default the agent sends security telemetry and file hashes: process names and command lines, file paths, network connection metadata, and detections. File contents are collected only if your organisation turns that on.
ui.during_the_free_trial_and_on: During the free trial, and on unpaid plans, the console shows Google AdSense adverts and the mobile apps show Google AdMob adverts, after asking for your consent. Subscribers see 95% fewer adverts. Adverts never appear on approval, containment, threat warning, quarantine review, sign-in, payment or audit screens.
ui.each_publish_creates_a_new_signed: Each publish creates a new signed version. Devices keep enforcing the last verified version while offline.
ui.equality_software_ltd_operates_agenti: Equality Software Ltd operates Agentic Antivirus. This page describes what the service collects. It must be reviewed by the product owner before publication.
ui.every_action_that_changes_a_device: Every action that changes a device, an account or traffic passes the policy engine and AEP-X governance. An approval covers one action, its exact targets, this organisation, and a fixed time.
ui.every_upload_is_checked_for_malware: Every upload is checked for malware and its real type. Files without a verified viewer are stored and downloadable but not previewed.
ui.get_the_agent_for_windows_mac: Get the agent for Windows, Mac or Linux from the
ui.go_to_devices_choose_enrol_a: Go to Devices, choose Enrol a device, and run the command shown on the computer you want to protect. The agent starts scanning as soon as it receives its signed policy.
ui.i_understand_devices_will_stop_scanni: I understand devices will stop scanning and blocking threats after the trial until a subscription is paid.
ui.include_the_language_model_if_your: Include the language model (if your organisation enabled one)
ui.known_malware_is_moved_to_quarantine: Known malware is moved to quarantine, where it cannot run. If you think a file was blocked by mistake, open Quarantine and request a review. An administrator decides, and the file comes back only after a fresh scan finds it clean.
ui.languages_without_a_complete_translat: Languages without a complete translation fall back to English. Coverage is measured, not estimated.
ui.management_hosts_kept_reachable_durin: Management hosts kept reachable during isolation
ui.name: Name
ui.name_of_the_secret_in_your: Name of the secret in your secret store, never the secret itself
ui.on_android_subscribe_in_the_agentic: On Android, subscribe in the Agentic Antivirus app through Google Play. On iPhone and iPad, App Store subscriptions are not available yet. Paying on the web is not available yet.
ui.per_user_covers_all_of_their: Per user (covers all of their devices)
ui.read_aloud_and_dictation_use_your: Read-aloud and dictation use your browser's built-in speech features. We do not record or store audio.
ui.stopping_processes_isolating_devices_: Stopping processes, isolating devices, restoring files, adding exclusions and changing traffic rules need a person to approve them. An approval covers one action, its exact targets and a limited time. If anything changes, approve again.
ui.subscribe_this_device_with_google_pla: Subscribe this device with Google Play
ui.the_assistant_groups_related_alerts_l: The assistant groups related alerts, lists what was observed with links to the evidence, and marks anything it cannot prove as a hypothesis. It can suggest actions but cannot approve them. If the model is unavailable, scanning, alerts and manual responses keep working.
ui.tls_only_must_be_on_the: TLS only, must be on the egress allowlist
ui.traffic_floods_are_absorbed_by_your: Traffic floods are absorbed by your upstream provider. Here you account for every public endpoint, watch provider alerts, and approve new traffic restrictions.
ui.turn_on_protection_to_scan_files: Turn on protection to scan files on this computer and watch for ransomware and credential theft.
ui.we_show_adverts_from_google_adsense: We show adverts from Google AdSense on some pages. Allow personalised adverts?

ui.your_organisation_gets_a_30_day: Your organisation gets a 30-day free trial. After that it costs £4.99 per month for each user or device.
ui.your_organisation_sets_how_long_telem: Your organisation sets how long telemetry and evidence are kept. Audit records cannot be edited or deleted.
